purpose: CT-01 census: which surfaces consume the canonical media contracts versus re-declaring them. One public schema exists (libs/audio-video-types); Java surfaces hold bounded domain/runtime projections that must map explicitly, never silently re-declare the public vocabulary.

canonical.owns: public TS request/result/error/job-state schemas — nine canonical job states + legacy machine-scoped spellings
canonical.parityGuard: tests/media-job-state-contract-parity.test.mjs locks MediaJobStateSchema to the PDP-1 canonicalStateEnum

six-value runtime status projection (ACCEPTED/RUNNING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED); every value has an explicit PDP-1 sourceStatus disposition
consumers.runtime-contracts MediaLifecycleProjecti: Java projection logic over runtime status; not a second public schema
consumers.stt-service AvTranscriptionJob.JobStatus: ten-value domain lifecycle (CREATED, QUEUED, PROCESSING, RETRY_PENDING, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, RECONCILING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED + deprecated RETRYING wire compat); mapped to CanonicalJobStatus through AvJobLifecycleAdapter — every enum value handled explicitly
consumers.adapters/ledger AudioVideoRunLedgerAdapt: bounded string→RunLedger mapping with exhaustive tables; unmapped input fails closed (b6e4873d)
consumers.integration-tests JobState: test-scoped fixture enum — never exported as a public contract

regeneratedPublicSchemas.meaning: second public zod/JSON schema for the same vocabulary — forbidden

guards.singlePublicSchema: only libs/audio-video-types may define the public zod contract surface for media job/artifact/error vocabulary
guards.explicitProjection: every Java-side enum value touching canonical semantics must pass an explicit mapping (adapter/projection); no unmapped fallthrough
guards.noLegacyPromotion: legacy spellings (RETRYING, CANCELLING) remain machine-scoped observations, never canonical outputs
